name: Belshazzar
summary: A king of Babylon who held a great feast and drank from the holy cups taken from God's temple in Jerusalem. A hand wrote a message on his wall, Daniel read it as God's judgment, and he was killed that same night.

key_moments.title: Drinks from the Temple Cups
key_moments.description: Belshazzar threw a great feast for a thousand lords and had the gold and silver cups from the temple in Jerusalem brought in. They drank wine from them and praised gods of gold, silver, wood and stone.

key_moments.title: Sees the Writing on the Wall
key_moments.description: The fingers of a human hand appeared and wrote on the palace wall. The king shook with fear, and none of his wise men could read the words.

key_moments.title: Weighed and Found Wanting
key_moments.description: Daniel told Belshazzar he had not humbled his heart, and read the writing: God had numbered his kingdom and ended it, and it would be given to the Medes and Persians. Belshazzar still clothed Daniel in scarlet and made him third ruler.

key_moments.title: Slain That Night
key_moments.description: That same night Belshazzar, king of the Chaldeans, was killed, and Darius the Median took the kingdom.
